Herdr fork preview: add, list and revoke paired device keys

Source: 35b5939916419c483adc108fd9dab85a3fe7a62c (PR #529).

Pair another device by its key: pair.add_key adds an ssh-ed25519 device key, and herdr pair --list / --revoke show and remove the keys pairing added (#529).

pair.add_key {public_key, label} writes only `ssh-ed25519 <key> herdr-pair:<label>` to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys and is idempotent on the key (a key already there, in any line, answers already); pair.keys.list lists the herdr-pair lines with their fingerprints, and pair.keys.remove removes them by fingerprint with an atomic rewrite. Only the owner's own connection can call them; servers advertise pair_add_key. QR pairing no longer writes the phone's own key comment into authorized_keys (#529).
